about: Lanterns in /images/hero-lanterns.jpg, measured on an 800 x 1200 copy: centre x, centre y, half width, half height of the paper ball, and the lowest point of the tassel. Front lanterns swing around a point above their centre; their exact edges come from scripts/assets/hero-lanterns-cut.png and these outlines only decide which lantern owns which pixel (scripts/cut-lanterns.py). Back lanterns are too small and tangled to cut, so they turn in place. Nearest first.
